four_business_fields_actually_read.full_chain_observation: 真实PotatoCannon.use server从注册表按ammo找type，生成owner玩家的PotatoProjectile、设置ammo、位置/速度并入world。固定baked_potato JSON接pre_entity_hit set_on_fire60。native onHitEntity先pop粒子/命中声，再拒poweredWither或执行preEntityHit；随后才保存目标fireTicks=k、可能由燃烧弹体ignite。server hurt=false时还原k、kill并return，跳过onEntityHit、回收/掉落、击退、原版命中玩家回执、sticky。SetOnFire先直接setRemainingFireTicks且returnfalse继续结算。
four_business_fields_actually_read.concrete_observation: 计1：实际原生失败回滚的作用域与阶段反馈次序，不是泛化所有箭伤拒绝。k在preEntityHit之后保存，故baked_potato的预先点火即使hurt=false也保留；rollback只撤掉之后燃烧弹体的ignite，不恢复入函数前所有状态。pop声/粒子可在damage/控制拒绝前出现，不能叫immune receipt。poweredWither提前return在pop之后且本分支不kill；Enderman hurt成功分支也提前return，不能把所有短路等同弹体消失。reload<10时写invulTime=reload+10仅在后段。

four_business_fields_actually_read.limitations: 完整onHitEntity、pop、damage helper、native use和type/命中action全文已读；所有ammo变体/注册/渲染mode包装不加数。基础Item.use网络及原版hurt内部未读，未运行上游，版本API不可直接移植。

four_business_fields_actually_read.full_chain_observation:
Registered Underzealot goals capture a valid ground-near sacrifice and startRiding without checking returned success. Target selection/hurt-alert suppressed while carrying/leader carrying/praying. Actual carrying sync flag is updated from passenger presence in server tick after super.tick.
Complete ritual goal separates follower and carrier eligibility. Followers seek ring positions, pray near altar and increment shared-looking but per-entity synced worship time; carrier >200 worship ticks plus >=3 praying followers triggers passenger.triggerSacrificeIn(300), then consumes local cloudCooldown400 and publishes event62. Validity/altar/position/digging and stop logic differ from later victim countdown.
Native hurt calls super first; only true plus isVehicle plus random<.65 ejects passengers. It does not itself clear victim isBeingSacrificed/sacrificeTime or immediately set carrying false. Goal stop resets worship/praying/particle position, ejects and conditionally sets carrier cooldown100. No rollback callback to committed victim timer.
Actual Gloomoth tick decrements armed sacrificeTime on server regardless of still being a passenger, then attempts Watcher conversion below0. Carrier postSacrifice/cooldown/advancement requires current Underzealot vehicle, but conversion does not. Vesper tick additionally requires isPassenger, so dismount pauses its timer without clearing the armed flag; later any passenger relation resumes, and conversion still does not require an Underzealot vehicle. Both trigger methods simply arm and replace timer.
Client events61/62 create particles/cloud,77 requests chant. ClientProxy type5 reuses sound by integer entity id and isSameEntity/alive; queues only if absent from queued/ticking lists and canPlaySound. UnderzealotSound canPlay requires !silent/praying/worship<MAX; running tick checks alive/praying, updates position/volume/pitch and stops otherwise. It does not itself stop when worship crosses MAX or silent changes. Removal clears map entry; no sound-manager stop call in that removal helper.
Native render burrow gate can suppress body; model carrying/praying interpolation reshapes pose, and armFreedom suppresses ordinary swing while carrying. These are state cues, not damage rejection text or verified visual feedback. Buried targetability/push/pick filters differ from hurt: own isInvulnerableTo only adds IN_WALL and super, not blanket buried invulnerability.
four_business_fields_actually_read.concrete_observation:
At most one complete multi-actor windup/quorum-to-victim-owned-committed timer family with damage-qualified unseating and divergent interruption semantics. Not Thrasher attempted-hit stun budget, Glider actual-HP accumulated grounding/target regrab lease, weight pickup lease, bubble release-source/dismount veto, TF global release gate, Betweenlands per-rider worldtick callback budget or Gammaroach attacker-mark cooldown spray. Registration, burial, sound cache, pose, random constant, two victim species and each goal/tick are support0, never separate credits. No universal damage immunity implementation is claimed.
独立复核后的限定：multi-actor仅指NPC pack而非真人双人；quorum只遍历链中PRAYING标志，不在该计数方法检查存活/实际站位，离开环位分支仅清worship而未清PRAYING，可能有陈旧标志。因此不是持续有效的几何/活体quorum。dismount/unseat指脱离乘骑，不能翻译成chunk unload。committed只指已武装未来runtime尝试，不是不可逆、持久、成功或恰一次转化。Gloomoth脱骑后仍倒计时，Vesper脱骑暂停但不清标志，之后任意乘骑可恢复。
four_business_fields_actually_read.application_to_boss_immune: Authority must distinguish application admission, windup interruption, committed future effect and feedback lifetime. A damage-success dismount cue is not proof an armed effect was canceled; a chanted/visible state is not immunity denial. Boss feedback should follow exact authoritative reason and target, with explicit cleanup at each phase; do not add ordinary-constitution gray text or copy this ritual/gameplay.
four_business_fields_actually_read.limitations:
Coordinator actually read all listed source ranges. Full Underzealot/three goals/PackAnimal/interface/renderer/model/sound; large proxy and victim files only specified methods/ranges, not entire files. Earlier combined output clipped registry lines, recovered80..84 and renderer call explicitly; no extra credit for recovery.
Vanilla hurt/forced eject/startRiding/AI scheduler/convertTo and Forge final listeners are not expanded or run. super.hurt true is API result, not independently measured HP loss; ejection attempted, not a runtime release guarantee. No double-side or exact tick-order proof.
Carrier pose/carrying sync can lag actual removal until server tick. Quorum sampled at trigger, not maintained throughout victim countdown. No method cancels victim armed timer here. Vesper only requires any passenger after armed, not still same carrier/altar/quorum; Gloomoth does not even require passenger. Do not claim interruptible channel after commitment.
Carrier own NBT saves sacrifice cooldown/buried/remerge/altar coordinates. Worship/praying/cloudCooldown and victim own armed/timer fields are not saved by these classes; inherited passenger/native save semantics not verified. No save/reopen or clone credit.
Goal altar test nested loops both start and end-2, so not a complete5x5 floor test. Mutable position movement in altar search retained as source; no geometry guarantee. Malformed buried save without remerge position can reach null uses; not fixed or reproduced.
Sound cache id equality is not UUID/dimension/session identity. A stopped matching sound object can be reused because type5 lacks isStopped recreation guard; do not assert restart success or sound-engine behavior. Clearing cache alone does not prove active sound stopped. No gray text, per-refusal nonce, damage ACK or measured sound/pixels/TCP.
The model/renderer were read as feedback consumers only, no specialist art design credit or modification. ACSoundRegistry individual entries/particle classes, engine transport and native transformation outcome not expanded. Distinct transformations/thresholds/sounds are not extra semantic implementations. Reference version API not asserted drop-in compatible with Dynasty Forge1.20.
One failed local Python CA request followed by bounded normal system-curl fixed-commit acquisition; raw blob verified. No SSL verification disabling, account/model/provider bypass, retry loop or download-time credit.
Semantic search only selected nine actual prior decision records; broad initial output was truncated and was not counted as reading. All nine decision fields were then explicitly recovered in bounded outputs. No claim to have reread their old source chains.
Multi-actor means NPC pack members, not player multiplayer coordination.
Use dismount/unseat, not chunk unload. Armed/timer fields are local runtime fields; searched complete victim files show their declaration, tick and trigger writes only, with no explicit save/load or cancel reset. No unload/reload persistence or ticking while unloaded is claimed.
Committed means the trigger has armed a future runtime attempt; it does not mean irreversible, durable, guaranteed conversion or exactly-once settlement.
No ongoing geometric quorum guarantee; stale praying flags are possible in the shown branch until another path clears them.
isValidSacrificePos loops i=-2..-2 and j=-2..-2; this does not validate a complete 5x5 floor. Do not generalize comments/intent to stronger actual admission.
No live audio, pixel rendering, packet transport, native engine internals, cross-mod composition or gameplay acceptance was tested.
主协调实际读取原9旧决策的完整实质字段；独立审阅另对比5旧决策，主协调只核其当前收据结论及哈希，不冒充亲自重读这5条字段或14条旧源链。22范围/14文件/两个牺牲目标/状态/声音/模型均支持0，只整链1。本接受未运行游戏/Java/编译、未改生产/专业资产/清单，未证明native或10小时。

author_observations: Actual WitherBoss.registerGoals installs RangedAttackGoal(this,1,40,20). Whole native goal caches current living target in canUse, checks line of sight during tick, and calls rangedAttackMob.performRangedAttack on counter reaching0 only if visible. Range affects navigation and cooldown factor, not an explicit final distance veto at shooting. Native scheduling/other goals remain external.

Three complete native Wither ranged overloads route central-head random dangerous flag, emit levelEvent1024 before spawn request when not silent, create actual WitherSkull with boss owner, setOwner again, dangerous flag if requested, head spawn position, then ignore addFreshEntity bool. Cue and constructor are not birth/admission proof. Other side-head AI already belongs to the historical phase owner; no separate credit.

Original skull branch remains: live owner type picks witherSkull(this,owner)8 versus ownerless/nonliving magic5; successful hurt then currently alive invokes enchantment followup, otherwise owner.heal5. New heal implementation first gets Forge event-modified amount, returns if<=0, and only calls setHealth if owner currently has positive health. Existing setHealth clamp is reused. Heal request is not health gain/kill causality.

Prior fixed full LivingEntity.hurt/actuallyHurt and native addEffect/canBeAffected refs are preserved with byte matches and reused0. ForgeHooks newly read attack/hurt/damage bridge shows event cancellations or altered amounts; no claim that hurt bool uniquely identifies actual positive HP loss, final Boss immunity, player override behavior or reason.

Native WitherBoss.hurt rejects isInvulnerableTo, WITHER_IMMUNE_TO tag or source owner instanceof WitherBoss; then charge phase unless bypass tag, powered direct AbstractArrow, and sameMobType nonplayer living owner. Before delegating accepted preflight to super it can arm destroyBlocksTick and increase idle head counters. Final super denial need not roll those local updates back. Tag resource values and all final receiver overrides not read.

Native WitherBoss.canBeAffected returnsfalse for exact MobEffects.WITHER before super, so this path does not reach base Applicable event. Base undead policy reused only denies regeneration/poison by default, not all harmful effects. The two different immunity predicates must not be conflated. No reason-specific refusal message or observer throttle here.

Skull WITHER request NORMAL200/HARD800ticks amplifier1 reaches prior addEffect virtual canBeAffected. Existing-effect update now read: weaker longer can insert/update hiddenEffect while returned flag staysfalse; equal/shorter no-op or presentation changes also affect bool. Ignored result cannot prove admitted active status or absence of any state mutation.

MobEffects.WITHER is the actual registered base MobEffect instance. MobEffectInstance.tick chooses remaining duration (or entity tickCount for infinite), applies before decrement and may restore hidden effect at zero; base WITHER tick predicate is40>>amplifier (amp1 gives20) and apply requests victim.damageSources().wither()1 without creator parameter. No guaranteed HP loss/attributed kill or universal20worldtick execution rate.

Native LivingEntity.tickEffects removes expired on server only if Expired event not vetoed, updates callbacks/dirty flags and effect particles; it catches ConcurrentModificationException. Added/updated callbacks send to server-player passengers, ServerPlayer overrides also send self/trigger criteria. This is effect sync, not refusal result or TCP/render acceptance; full renderer/registry/event mutation effects remain external.

Original native collision now has query body: ProjectileUtil move vector starts from current position, clips blocks, then closest eligible entity along shortened segment; used level overload creates EntityHitResult(entity), and no source position write occurs here. Skull explosion uses current x/y/z after parent dispatch, not a promised ray-surface location. All world clip math and reentrant callbacks remain external.

Forge impact wrapper reads onProjectileImpactResult()!=DEFAULT. Cancellation maps SKIP_ENTITY; every nonDEFAULT enum suppresses this AbstractHurtingProjectile.onHit call, even STOP names: this caller does not locally implement enum documentation by discarding/stopping. Nullable sister API is not the API this skull tick uses. Comments cannot substitute actual caller behavior.

Native Level chooses MOB explosion block policy from mobGriefing event and drop-decay rule. KEEP skips block destruction, not Explosion.explode entity computation. EntityBased calculator delegates resistance/shouldBlockExplode to actual skull; dangerous resistance cap is conditional, not final block admission. Fire=false prevents this explosion fire-placement branch.

Whole Explosion: ray resistance/geometry computes toBlow; Detonate publishes live block and entity lists, not a cancelable event. Its commented preliminary entity filter is disabled. Each eligible non-ignoreExplosion victim within normalized radius and nonzero direction is hurt after visibility factor. Returned hurt bool is ignored, then blast-protection-adjusted vector is added via setDeltaMovement and qualified players stored in hitPlayers. No final control result is returned; request is not actual displaced position and not necessarily ordinary knockback event.

Explosion Start cancellation makes Level return its constructed object before own explode/finalize, but ServerLevel outer nine-arg override still clears KEEP block list and sends packet to this level players with distanceSq<4096. A cancel-only listener that does not mutate/call the object leaves default empty blocks/hitPlayers; packet receives null motion aszero. Live maps/lists are exposed, so arbitrary listeners may alter this and no universal canceled-explosion-empty guarantee is made.

Complete packet carries coordinates/power/copied block list and three motion floats, not victim UUID/reason/accepted-effect/damage/canceled bit. Client handler ensures main thread, constructs client Explosion from packet, calls finalizeExplosion(true) and adds motion to current player delta. Thus even empty/cancel-only server outcome can request local explosion sound/particle; no actual visual/audio/network execution proof. Server and client are separate entity instances, so this is not a claim of double impulse on one object.

Whole Explosion.finalize uses client-side local sound, optional explosion particle, block list drops/requests if block policy allows, and optional fire. Its ordinary cue is independent of a specific victim accepted damage/control. Skull discard occurs after normal return of server explosion request whether hurt or effect was accepted; exception/reentry/restart/idempotent native receipt behavior not established.

Projectile.tick initializes hasBeenShot and tests leaving owner/root vehicle; parent canHitEntity first uses target.canBeHitByProjectile, then owner/leftOwner/shared-vehicle gate; AbstractHurtingProjectile further rejects noPhysics. This is local admission, not final target damage/control policy.

Projectile.onHit calls concrete onHitEntity then emits PROJECTILE_LAND at the hit location, or calls block.onProjectileHit then the block-position land event. Its native onHitEntity body is empty. No damage-success return is propagated by this dispatch.

new_additional_nearest_complete_formal_o.concrete_observation: 拒晕是明确Applicable DENY，而不是血量是否变化；Temblor不检查addEffect成功且super.explodeHurt的push在hurt成功判断之外，拒晕不能推出无伤或纹丝不动。MobUtil.push按击退抗性缩放整个(原速度+增量)，并设置hasImpulse，非LivingKnockBackEvent，所以仅TANGLED的onKnockback取消不能证明此push被挡。拒晕分支无专门文字、微光、嗡声或限频；范围smash粒子/爆炸声不论单体是否拒晕都可发生。普通已中晕行为取消与拒晕是两个语义，不能把取消use包装各计一条。死亡清理包发ALL且仅实体ID，在另维度同ID可能误命中，客户端实体缺失直接丢，不含维度/UUID/代际。第三方stun兼容靠descriptionId.contains字符串，未证明实际格式命中。
new_additional_nearest_complete_formal_o.application_to_boss_immune: Boss控制免疫须在明确拒绝处生成原因回执；状态未加上不保证击退/动作没发生。声音/文字节流应随拒绝事件独立而不能用AOE总声或已有状态清理包代替。type9普通体质不用追加Boss灰字。
new_additional_nearest_complete_formal_o.limitations: 读取了实际施法结果、范围伤害、push和拒绝监听的完整方法；未展开整个施法物品选择系统或运行原生施法。unstunnable标签资源不在本地Java缓存，未确认具体Boss成员，不能宣称某Boss已覆盖；静态记录机制及明确缺口。泛用网络和深度保护仅链路辅助0额外计数。

complete_author_observations: 原生RAVAGER工厂、属性、RavagerMeleeAttackGoal注册、整个MeleeAttackGoal已读。goal在攻击距离和冷却满足时先重置冷却、swing，再调用实际Ravager.doHurtTarget，忽略结果。Ravager先attackTick=10、事件4和攻击声，才调用父类攻击；攻击动作不是命中结果。
Mob.doHurtTarget先计算伤害/击退、可预先点火，再调用目标hurt。只有其返回true，才追加普通击退、盾禁用、附魔效果和lastHurtMob。Player.hurt自身先有onPlayerAttack、能力无敌、死亡、难度/零伤门，才进入LivingEntity；ServerPlayer外层与任意自定义目标不在完整审查范围。

LivingEntity.hurt先onLivingAttack、源无敌、客户端、死亡、火抗门。正伤且isDamageSourceBlocked时产生ShieldBlockEvent；未取消才按事件扣盾耐久/减blocked量，非projectile且directEntity为Living才调用blockUsingShield。默认Living委托攻击者blockedByShield(this)，Player覆写先super再检查能否disableShield。
ShieldBlockEvent默认blocked为全部原伤，可钳位改至0，也可取消或不伤盾。实际callback不要求getBlockedDamage>0，也不等待最终flag、iframe或actuallyHurt；未取消且blocked=0仍可到callback只是源码条件，不主张存在实际设置0的监听器或已复现。
Ravager.blockedByShield仅在roarTick==0生效；随机<.5设置自身stunnedTick40、眩晕声和事件39，再对盾方调用push(this)；否则直接strongKnockback盾方。两个分支都将盾方hurtMarked=true。未要求当前stunnedTick==0，因此眩晕期间被外部再次调用可重设40；自然AI当时是否能再次攻击不能据方法本身保证。
自身isImmobile包含attack/stun/roar任一正计数，hasLineOfSight在stun/roar时false。Living aiStep局部显示immobile清jump/xxa/zza并跳serverAiStep，Ravager自身aiStep在super后仍对存活体递减计数；未声称动量/外力/所有AI或世界tick完全冻结。
Ravager先处理roar递减及==10释放，再attack递减，再stun递减。stun变0时请求吼声并设置roar20，刚设置的roar不在该次前部再递减。roar期阻止新的shield callback反应；真实墙钟、加载/NoAI/调度不作等价推算。

complete_author_observations: 原生RAVAGER工厂、属性、RavagerMeleeAttackGoal注册、整个MeleeAttackGoal已读。goal在攻击距离和冷却满足时先重置冷却、swing，再调用实际Ravager.doHurtTarget，忽略结果。Ravager先attackTick=10、事件4和攻击声，才调用父类攻击；攻击动作不是命中结果。
Mob.doHurtTarget先计算伤害/击退、可预先点火，再调用目标hurt。只有其返回true，才追加普通击退、盾禁用、附魔效果和lastHurtMob。Player.hurt自身先有onPlayerAttack、能力无敌、死亡、难度/零伤门，才进入LivingEntity；ServerPlayer外层与任意自定义目标不在完整审查范围。

actual_fourfield_projection.full_chain_observation:
Actual registered chain: @Mod constructor installs setup; ChampionCapability.register installs both event handlers; concrete ShieldingAffix is put into ID/category registry. LivingEntity+Enemy qualification attaches capability. Spawn/JoinWorld without rank installs selected affixes and invokes initial callbacks, but Shielding inherits empty onInitialSpawn/onSpawn. No default active mode or initial sync is implied.
On delivered server LivingUpdate, outer tickCount%10 condition and inner tickCount%40 plus float<0.5 gate invert current side-owned BooleanData. Only successful sample saves mode and requests tracking packet. A failed sample preserves either active or inactive phase; hits never spend shield or alter sampling. There is no deterministic finite active deadline or two-second shield lease in this code.
Delivered server LivingAttack iterates all target affixes. Shielding exact OUT_OF_WORLD reference exception returns true before sound; other attacks when stored mode true submit no-damage sound then return false, causing caller setCanceled(true). No amount>0, attacker owner, per-hit RNG, hit budget, resource debit or source tag predicate. Later true returns cannot undo cancellation, iteration does not short-circuit until after all target affixes; then canceled skips attacker callbacks. Native Forge dispatch of an already-canceled event is not expanded.
BasicAffix sends concrete affix data through registered SPacketSyncAffixData. Codec carries integer entity ID, affix ID and CompoundTag only. Enqueued consumer checks current world/capability/mapped affix and applies readSyncTag/saveData; no UUID/dimension/generation, pending replay or delivery acknowledgment. A handled packet is not proof state applied. Native channel scheduling and world lifetime unexecuted.
Actual StartTracking sends SPacketSyncChampion rank/color/affix names, without mode. Its client consumer installs rank/list; no concrete Shielding callback supplies current state initially. Under fresh empty client data and already-active server state, observer can lack true display until a later toggle; that first successful toggle may be false. This is a conditional source boundary, not live desynchronization reproduced or bounded wait.
Client onLivingUpdate invokes installed affix onClientUpdate before rank showParticles condition. Shielding true local mode requests one white ENTITY_EFFECT at random body position each delivered update. showParticles gate controls later rank particles, not Shielding particles. This state presentation differs from unthrottled per-incoming-attack no-damage sound; neither is a proven target-authenticated refusal receipt or native delivered sensory evidence.
Client.setAffixes clears its list but not idToAffix or data maps. A removed mapped affix can still accept an ID state packet, while no longer in tick list; previously received data need not be fresh default on reused capability. AffixData constructs a data object and reads side map; reflection can return null with unchecked callers. Native CompoundTag missing/wrong-type semantics not expanded; fresh Java boolean field alone is not proof of all decoded tag defaults.
Conversion creates/uses different capability then copies rank/affix references and invokes empty Shielding initial callback; it does not explicitly copy old private data. Save reader hasUUID versus compound mismatch and generic maps remain existing migration owner28be6a, not fresh credit. No guaranteed native reload reset, natural champion spawn, cross-version1.20.1 support or all-affix certification.

If native lifetime keeps the same object but changes dimension/ID, removal can miss old membership. Old-ID reuse is not prevented by membership type. Eligible server branch calls handleImportantEntityTicks then cancels. Part.hurt first consults own isInvulnerableTo, then passes actual part to parent. Server root.hurt passes body; root client returns false. Parent multipart overload has no own explicit side gate; do not assert every part call independently server-gated.

AbstractDragonSittingPhase onHurt lights direct AbstractArrow for1second then returns0. Other sources inherit unchanged amount. Phase/refusal mutates the direct arrow before source eligibility; no refusal text/unique status/target-window feedback produced here. Lighting is a source state request, not measured pixels/audio.
Crucial subtype boundary: initial HOVERING reports isSitting true but inherits AbstractDragonPhaseInstance.onHurt unchanged, not AbstractDragonSittingPhase. Sitting-budget eligibility must not be equated with arrow-refusal eligibility.
For eligible source capture f=current HP then invoke reallyHurt->LivingEntity.hurt; wrapper ignores bool. Afterward current phase is queried again, so no claim of a captured immutable phase across parent hooks. If HP<=0 and then-current phase not sitting, setHealth1 and switch DYING.
If then-current phase is sitting, add f-currentHP to private sittingDamageReceived, regardless native hurt bool. Strictly >.25*maxHP resets accumulator0 and requests TAKEOFF. Exactly25% does not trigger. This is observed pre/post HP difference, not raw attack amount nor success-event nominal damage quota.

actual_fourfield_projection.concrete_observation:
The policy is phase-managed measurement of actual pre/post native health followed by phase retirement and teardown. All root/part source admission, arrow subclass response, helpers, cues, counters, manager and own persistence belong to one whole at most.
Parent multipart damage checks DYING, then phase onHurt, then nonhead scaling and .01 threshold. Only Player-owned or the actual ALWAYS_HURTS_ENDER_DRAGONS damage tag reaches reallyHurt; other admitted source returns true without parent damage.
AbstractDragonSittingPhase ignites a direct AbstractArrow for one second then returns zero before source-owner eligibility. HOVERING isSitting true but inherits unchanged onHurt from AbstractDragonPhaseInstance. Boolean sitting is not arrow-denial subtype identity.
Parent records f=getHealth, invokes superclass hurt and ignores its return, then re-queries current phase. This is not a frozen phase lease across hook consumers.
In then-current sitting phase f-currentHP feeds sittingDamageReceived; strictly above .25*maxHP resets zero and requests TAKEOFF. Exactly threshold stays. An absorbed/canceled hit can contribute zero; hook-induced heal can algebraically reduce the counter. No demonstrated exploit or runtime outcome.
Observed-HP accumulation differs from Lycanites successfed nominal per-second quota+nexttick rollback and Minister refused-hit staff nominal expenditure. It also differs from Wilden absolute HP threshold clamp and Gaia elapsed phase timers. These whole prior owners remain zero extra.
Closest Draconic whole already owns source/part/phase gates, true-without-HP and nonstationary lethal HP1/DYING support, so those overlapping ideas are zero new. Its complete523..584 does not measure and accumulate sitting HP deltas to retire via TAKEOFF; this measured-delta lifecycle supports at most one related whole, no universal novelty claim.
Manager end-before-new-instance/server DATA_PHASE-write/begin and root at-most-one immediate second server phase tick are actual source transitions. Phase-owned flaming end discards its cloud. Normal source return is assumed; hook exceptions, network and engine scheduling are unproved.
Landing resets flame count; scanning may choose takeoff/charge without damage; attacking postincrements a40 tick condition then enters flaming; flaming200 or count4 can choose scan/takeoff. Those counters are not new research references or measured wall seconds.
Only root field declaration/update/threshold/reset occur in complete lexical search. Relevant complete phase begin/end methods show no additional accumulator reset. Own save/read persists DragonPhase/DragonDeathTime but omits accumulator; not full external serialization or native reopen proof.
LivingEntity hurt actuallyHurt apply hooks, invulnerability, side/dead, cooldown, armor/magic/absorption and final hook before health mutation, while broadcasts, knockback, death/totem calls may precede return. HP1 assignment after return cannot certify rollback of all death side effects or runtime resurrection.
Root crystal healing before phase dispatch uses direct setHealth and does not edit this accumulator. Crystal destruction requests head explosion10 then dispatches to current phase; exact merged tag contents and fight creation remain unreviewed.
Own addEffect/ride/dimension refusals are supporting context zero and cannot be treated as a complete generic control-immunity feedback implementation. Existing sounds/particles are phase/death cues without a new per-target denial receipt.

complete_original_object.full_chain_observation:
Actual registered chain: @Mod constructor installs setup; ChampionCapability.register installs both event handlers; concrete ShieldingAffix is put into ID/category registry. LivingEntity+Enemy qualification attaches capability. Spawn/JoinWorld without rank installs selected affixes and invokes initial callbacks, but Shielding inherits empty onInitialSpawn/onSpawn. No default active mode or initial sync is implied.
On delivered server LivingUpdate, outer tickCount%10 condition and inner tickCount%40 plus float<0.5 gate invert current side-owned BooleanData. Only successful sample saves mode and requests tracking packet. A failed sample preserves either active or inactive phase; hits never spend shield or alter sampling. There is no deterministic finite active deadline or two-second shield lease in this code.
Delivered server LivingAttack iterates all target affixes. Shielding exact OUT_OF_WORLD reference exception returns true before sound; other attacks when stored mode true submit no-damage sound then return false, causing caller setCanceled(true). No amount>0, attacker owner, per-hit RNG, hit budget, resource debit or source tag predicate. Later true returns cannot undo cancellation, iteration does not short-circuit until after all target affixes; then canceled skips attacker callbacks. Native Forge dispatch of an already-canceled event is not expanded.
BasicAffix sends concrete affix data through registered SPacketSyncAffixData. Codec carries integer entity ID, affix ID and CompoundTag only. Enqueued consumer checks current world/capability/mapped affix and applies readSyncTag/saveData; no UUID/dimension/generation, pending replay or delivery acknowledgment. A handled packet is not proof state applied. Native channel scheduling and world lifetime unexecuted.
Actual StartTracking sends SPacketSyncChampion rank/color/affix names, without mode. Its client consumer installs rank/list; no concrete Shielding callback supplies current state initially. Under fresh empty client data and already-active server state, observer can lack true display until a later toggle; that first successful toggle may be false. This is a conditional source boundary, not live desynchronization reproduced or bounded wait.
Client onLivingUpdate invokes installed affix onClientUpdate before rank showParticles condition. Shielding true local mode requests one white ENTITY_EFFECT at random body position each delivered update. showParticles gate controls later rank particles, not Shielding particles. This state presentation differs from unthrottled per-incoming-attack no-damage sound; neither is a proven target-authenticated refusal receipt or native delivered sensory evidence.
Client.setAffixes clears its list but not idToAffix or data maps. A removed mapped affix can still accept an ID state packet, while no longer in tick list; previously received data need not be fresh default on reused capability. AffixData constructs a data object and reads side map; reflection can return null with unchecked callers. Native CompoundTag missing/wrong-type semantics not expanded; fresh Java boolean field alone is not proof of all decoded tag defaults.
Conversion creates/uses different capability then copies rank/affix references and invokes empty Shielding initial callback; it does not explicitly copy old private data. Save reader hasUUID versus compound mismatch and generic maps remain existing migration owner28be6a, not fresh credit. No guaranteed native reload reset, natural champion spawn, cross-version1.20.1 support or all-affix certification.

Luna already owns source-category random resampling at its saved countdown; this boolean inversion can retain either phase without any deadline, and initial name-only snapshot omits current mode. Mode sync/particles/per-hit sound are one policy, not separate references. Migration28be6a already owns persistence/conversion/Adaptable memory, all supporting0 here. Original native collision now has query body: ProjectileUtil move vector starts from current position, clips blocks, then closest eligible entity along shortened segment; used level overload creates EntityHitResult(entity), and no source position write occurs here. Skull explosion uses current x/y/z after parent dispatch, not a promised ray-surface location. All world clip math and reentrant callbacks remain external.

Forge impact wrapper reads onProjectileImpactResult()!=DEFAULT. Nullable sister API is not the API this skull tick uses. Comments cannot substitute actual caller behavior.

Native Level chooses MOB explosion block policy from mobGriefing event and drop-decay rule. KEEP skips block destruction, not Explosion.explode entity computation. EntityBased calculator delegates resistance/shouldBlockExplode to actual skull; dangerous resistance cap is conditional, not final block admission. Fire=false prevents this explosion fire-placement branch.

Whole Explosion: ray resistance/geometry computes toBlow; Detonate publishes live block and entity lists, not a cancelable event. Its commented preliminary entity filter is disabled. Each eligible non-ignoreExplosion victim within normalized radius and nonzero direction is hurt after visibility factor. Returned hurt bool is ignored, then blast-protection-adjusted vector is added via setDeltaMovement and qualified players stored in hitPlayers. No final control result is returned; request is not actual displaced position and not necessarily ordinary knockback event.

Explosion Start cancellation makes Level return its constructed object before own explode/finalize, but ServerLevel outer nine-arg override still clears KEEP block list and sends packet to this level players with distanceSq<4096. A cancel-only listener that does not mutate/call the object leaves default empty blocks/hitPlayers; packet receives null motion aszero. Live maps/lists are exposed, so arbitrary listeners may alter this and no universal canceled-explosion-empty guarantee is made.

Complete packet carries coordinates/power/copied block list and three motion floats, not victim UUID/reason/accepted-effect/damage/canceled bit. Client handler ensures main thread, constructs client Explosion from packet, calls finalizeExplosion(true) and adds motion to current player delta. Thus even empty/cancel-only server outcome can request local explosion sound/particle; no actual visual/audio/network execution proof. Server and client are separate entity instances, so this is not a claim of double impulse on one object.

Whole Explosion.finalize uses client-side local sound, optional explosion particle, block list drops/requests if block policy allows, and optional fire. Its ordinary cue is independent of a specific victim accepted damage/control. Skull discard occurs after normal return of server explosion request whether hurt or effect was accepted; exception/reentry/restart/idempotent native receipt behavior not established.

full_chain_observation: WitherSkull extends the two actually-read native parents. AbstractHurtingProjectile.tick enters client or server-owner/chunk condition, calls Projectile.tick, queries ProjectileUtil, and only dispatches a non-MISS impact if the Forge impact hook does not cancel. Hook/query implementations not read.

Projectile.tick initializes hasBeenShot and tests leaving owner/root vehicle; parent canHitEntity first uses target.canBeHitByProjectile, then owner/leftOwner/shared-vehicle gate; AbstractHurtingProjectile further rejects noPhysics. This is local admission, not final target damage/control policy.

Projectile.onHit calls concrete onHitEntity then emits PROJECTILE_LAND at the hit location, or calls block.onProjectileHit then the block-position land event. Its native onHitEntity body is empty. No damage-success return is propagated by this dispatch.

Skull onHitEntity is server-only after super. Living owner selects witherSkull source8; true hurt then currently alive target requests enchantment damage effects, otherwise requests owner.heal5. Nonliving/missing owner instead selects magic5. Neither hurt=true nor !isAlive proves actual positive HP damage or this projectile causal kill; downstream bodies not read.

Only hurt=true plus living target enters difficulty choice: NORMAL10/HARD40 seconds, amplifier1 WITHER with effect source getOwner or projectile fallback. Easy/peaceful choose0 and no request. addEffect boolean is ignored; no explicit living-target still-alive gate before the request. Not an admitted-effect or immune-reason receipt.

Skull.onHit always continues after parent onHit returns; server requests power1 nonfire MOB explosion at current projectile x/y/z, then discard, independent of the local entity hurt bool. Hit point/event location and explosion current position must not be conflated. External exceptions/hooks/final explosion computation are outside read scope.

AbstractHurtingProjectile.tick has no explicit return after its onHit call; checkInsideBlocks, motion, inertia/water trail and setPos follow in this local method. That does not prove discarded entities visibly continue flight or establish client/server outcomes.

Skull own hurt alwaysfalse and isPickablefalse override the parent hurt deflection body that changes motion/owner. They do not prove universal external control immunity or an explicit refusal reason, and shouldBurnfalse/isOnFirefalse are not a full fire damage gate.

Dangerous flag defaultsfalse in synced data, changes inertia from parent0.95 to0.73 and caps block resistance at0.8 only when block canEntityDestroy. These are variants/helper state0, not separate examples or proof explosion block permission/success.

Parent cached owner UUID lookup/effect-source fallback, power persistence and spawn-packet owner id are support0. No sameUUID admission/material/payment/quest or production acceptance follows from any constructor, sound, game event, particles, discard or raw count.
